data.raw_text:
Members of Citizens Crime Watch held a protest at Liwasang Bonifacio on Wednesday, July 30, to show support for the Rule of Law and the Supreme Court.

The group, joined by Duterte Youth, concerned lawyers, and various citizen organizations, also announced the filing of contempt charges against individuals accused of launching abusive attacks on the judiciary. (Photos by Mark Balmores/MB)
